config.windows: Detail Keeper Segmenter (pause 0.45 s after 2 s, cap 8 s), fed 0.1 s at a time; short windows held (min speech 4.0 s, hold 1.0 s)
config.list_feature: spotter shortlist of the whole list -> writer prompt + taught recordings
config.fit: no limit: the spotter ranks every name

fixes.guard: an empty list answer gets the no-list text
fixes.level: taught recordings scaled to the window's speech RMS (louder half of 20 ms frames)
fixes.short: a pause cuts a window with under 4.0 s of speech only after 1.0 s of quiet
fixes.name_guard: under 1.2 s of speech, a written listed name the no-list text lacks, letter agreement < 0.55 and recording match (emb) < -0.48: the no-list text
fixes.reread: a window with under 4.0 s of speech and a neighbour is written again with up to 4.0 s either side (10.0 s at most) and the merged shortlists, keeping its part of the answer

config.trace: per-window plain / written / final text in extra.windows
